notes: Specialized operation wizard deep links must not reintroduce generic operation-create prerequisites. Bulk Email uses fair_emails.execute. Enrichment remains accessible with scraper.execute alone because its fair filter is optional. Scraper Start remains authorized by scraper.execute, but entering its wizard additionally requires fairs.read and scraper.read because the user must deliberately discover/select a fair and adapter/manifest before the action can be configured. Duplicate Check uses operations.execute plus its legitimate data_operations.read page prerequisite. The generic /operations/new route and unknown generic operation wizard fallback continue to require operations.create.
